prep_label: Bazi case collection bounded source-selection prep
boundary_note: Case titles can proceed only to later single-source selection; no operational claim is inferred from case labels.
rationale: The case collection cluster is ordinary risk but too broad for direct registration, so this prep step limits it to bounded source selection later.
guardrails: Do not infer conclusions from case-title labels.
Select one bounded source-level record before registration.
Keep concise paraphrase and weak locator policy for any later candidate.

prep_label: Bazi practical formula bounded source-selection prep
boundary_note: Formula-style labels can proceed only to later single-source selection; formula labels are not treated as verified rules.
rationale: The practical formula cluster is ordinary risk but needs source-specific boundary review before registration or learning use.
guardrails: Do not treat formula labels as verified content.
Select one bounded source-level record before registration.
Keep conditional language until source-specific review exists.

boundary_note: Sensitive relationship, psychology, and advice labels remain behind risk review before any source selection or learning use.
rationale: The sensitive topic cluster needs explicit boundary wording and safety review; no source-level record is eligible in this prep step.
guardrails: Do not use relationship or psychology labels for deterministic claims.
Do not create source-library, candidate, review, promotion, or evidence records.
Require a separate risk-review step before any source selection.
